name.full: MEOK AI Labs — Trade Compliance + Attestation

description.full: MEOK is the public attestation layer for 32 PyPI-published Model Context Protocol servers covering trade-compliance regulators across 9 jurisdictions and 4 modes (road, air, sea, rail). The verifier endpoint is public + rate-limited; sign requires an API key. Every signed attestation auto-bridges to EU AI Act + UK AI Bill + NIST AI RMF + ISO/IEC 42001 via a single governance MCP.
